model_arch: GlmMoeDsaForCausalLM (glm_moe_dsa; DeepSeek-V3.2-DSA-class: MLA + sparse-attention lightning indexer + fine-grained block-fp8 MoE, 78 layers, 256 experts top-8 + 1 shared, hidden 6144, 1M max ctx)
version: plow @ glm-dsa-consolidated 94f36f6 (integrate + perf + nonflash consolidated; full 78-layer real-weight bring-up on glm-sweep-256k)
gpu: AMD gfx950 (MI350X-class, CDNA4), 8-GPU node; ROCR_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1,2,3 pins shard GPUs (HSA binary; HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES is ignored). 288 GiB/card.
quantization: fp8 block (e4m3, weight_block_size [128,128], dynamic acts) — experts + attn/dense projections + indexer wq_b/wk block-fp8; norms/router/embed/lm_head + MLA-derived + k_norm/weights_proj bf16
dtype: bfloat16 (compute; MLA latent KV bf16; index-key cache bf16 [ctx][128])
metric: tpot_ms (median 1-token decode step, ms/tok, 21 steps after 2 warmup)
methodology: SINGLE full-model pkt emitted at max_ctx=262144 (256k), TP4, then swept via glm52_decode --sweep over ctx=1k..256k (synthetic kv_len, timing-representative; the harness patches kv_len per point). Two pkts: gather-ON (default, DSA armed since emit-ctx>2048, 3158 ops) and dense (PLOW_GLM_DSA=0, 2990 ops). Each rank binds 183.3 GiB of block-fp8 weights (fits 288 GiB). MLA latent + index-key KV at 256k is small. Weight ~179-183 GiB/rank; TP shards MLA head-proj/dense-FFN/256-experts col/row-parallel + XReduce all-reduce.
tuning: consolidated glm-dsa (fast-indexer interp path); DSA gather ON
coherence: FULL 78-layer TP4 real-weight decode is COHERENT (first full-model run). Prompt 'The capital of France is' greedily continues 'Paris. Distance from Paris to Lyon is 391 km, while distance from Paris to Marseille is 661 km' (dense, PLOW_GLM_DSA=0). Gather-ON is BIT-IDENTICAL to dense at kv_len<=index_topk (sparse set == full cache) — 24/24 generated ids equal — with the DSA small-kv coherence fix (see notes). Confirms the emitted indexer->INDEX_SCORE->radix INDEX_SELECT->FLASH_GATHER pipeline executes coherently end-to-end.
dsa_coherence_fix: Pre-fix, gather-ON emitted GARBAGE at any kv_len<ctx: d_index_score_fast wrote Score only for t<kv_len, and d_index_select_coop ranks top-k over the FULL kv_stride (it is not passed kv_len), so uninitialized-score positions were selected and the gather flash attended uninitialized latent rows. Fix (op_attention.h, timing-neutral for the sweep since kv_len==ctx there): (1) sentinel Score[t in [len,kv_stride)] = -inf so only valid positions can be selected; (2) gather flash masks idx slots with ibase[kv]>=len (exp(-inf)=0) so surplus slots when kv_len<top_k contribute nothing. Interp occupancy preserved: VGPR 176->178, spill 0, occ 2. Measured tpot below is the consolidated (pre-fix) build; the fix does not change kv_len==ctx timing.
notes: Dense grows linearly with ctx (flash attention over the full cache: 42.7ms@1k -> 75.8ms@256k). Gather is near-CONSTANT (~51-54ms; reads a fixed index_topk=2048 latent rows + a mild-ctx indexer score/radix-select) -> the DSA constant-cost signature. Crossover at ~64k (dense 51.60 ~ gather 51.60); gather wins above it, 1.41x @256k. Below ~32k the always-armed indexer overhead makes gather slower (in production a short-ctx request uses a <=2048 dense pkt).
